把木纹、掉漆、铁锈与划痕分成可编辑材质图，再把厚度、断裂、纤维和接触阴影落实到一: Separate wood grain, peeling paint, rust and scratches into editable material graphs, then realize thickness, fractures, fibers and contact shadows in a reopenable crate scene. The final lookdev combines 178 crate meshes, two Designer graphs and 13 packed textures.
从已有参考建立一只约 2.2 m 长的风化木箱，保留宽木板、薄压条、金属包角和曲: Build a weathered wooden crate approximately 2.2 m long from the existing reference, retaining broad planks, thin battens, metal corner fittings and curved latches. Control aged paint and rust procedurally, use actual geometry for fracture silhouettes, and maintain correct color spaces and physical texture density for exported PBR textures in Blender.
通过 DCC-MCP，在 Substance 3D Designer 与 Ble: Use DCC-MCP to create a weathered wooden crate approximately 2.2 m long in Substance 3D Designer and Blender. Use broad planks, 30 mm battens, riveted corner fittings and curved latches. Olive-green paint should peel naturally, with rust and scratches independently controlling metalness and roughness. Battens should have layered fractures and attached, tapered wood fibers; the lower front plank should have a tapered dent. Export 2048×2048 wood and 1024×1024 steel PBR textures, retaining editable SBS/SBSAR files. Use sRGB color textures and Non-Color data textures. Maintain a physical wood-grain density of approximately one repeat per 0.45 m. Ensure actual ground contact for all four feet. Use Cycles to render the hero image, fracture and dent details, a UV check image and complete node graphs. Reopen the saved scene and materials, then verify packed texture bytes, mesh counts, bounding box and file hashes. Record actual MCP tool calls; explicitly report unavailable capabilities, without bypassing them through direct application scripts.
